title: subject.rs: ? inside pattern loop exits function on parse failure
description: Lines 167-168: parse().ok()? inside the for loop exits parse_subject entirely if a capture group fails to parse as u32, rather than continuing to try the next pattern. Masked by 6-digit regex limit (999999 < u32::MAX), so no practical bug today. Fix: replace ? with .ok() followed by continue, or add a comment explaining the invariant that makes this safe.
close_reason: Fixed: ? replaced with explicit match+continue so a failed parse on one pattern tries subsequent patterns.
